raw_text:
Maya Chen
Senior Frontend Engineer, Portland OR
maya.chen@example.com

Summary
Senior frontend engineer with 7 years of experience building consumer web products.

Skills
React, TypeScript, Next.js, GraphQL, Jest, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript

Experience

Senior Frontend Engineer at Brightline Commerce (2021 to 2026)
Led the storefront rebuild in React and TypeScript, serving two million monthly shoppers.
Moved the product catalog to Next.js server components, cutting page load times by 40 percent.
Designed the GraphQL layer for checkout and profile data.
Introduced Jest component testing and raised coverage to 85 percent.
Built the design system on Tailwind CSS.

Frontend Engineer at Juniper Media (2019 to 2021)
Built interactive editorial pages in JavaScript and React.
Shipped a live election results dashboard read by 300 thousand people.

Education
BS Computer Science, University of Oregon, 2019
